in_marathi.name: Jagathi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jagathi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। She who fills the universe with her presence. Derived from the root 'Jagat' meaning the universe and 'I' signifying the self. A divine feminine name revered in Hindu mythology.

in_bengali.name: Jagathi
in_bengali.long_meaning: Jagathi একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। She who fills the universe with her presence. Derived from the root 'Jagat' meaning the universe and 'I' signifying the self. A divine feminine name revered in Hindu mythology.
